title: Grateful Dead Live at Fillmore West on 1970-06-07

ai_review.summary: Clear soundboard recording of a loose, free‑form ’70s show highlighted by a smoking Cumberland Blues and The Other One
ai_review.review: Fans rave about the crystal‑clear soundboard capture and the unstructured, improvisational vibe of this early‑’70s performance. Standout moments include a powerful Cumberland Blues, an inspired run through Me and My Uncle → Speedway, and a politically charged The Other One; the only complaints focus on track‑splitting quirks and a rough first take of Sugar Magnolia.

ai_rating.rationale: Average user rating is ~4.1, most comments praise both the music and audio quality; only minor technical grievances were noted.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Consistently described as crisp, clear and period‑accurate. Minor criticisms concern missing seconds in Cumberland Blues and excessive track splitting that disrupts the listening flow.

show_quality.setlist_flow: A free‑form, loosely structured set that feels spontaneous and unstructured; the second set opens with The Other One and includes long ambient chatter and anti‑war protest interludes.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Occasional spoken interjection (possible JG) noted; overall guitar work praised as great.
band_member_comments.Drums: Drums segment highlighted for its intensity and the surrounding anti‑war shouting, adding historic atmosphere.
